source: Dual mode (2026-11-18): the mean of two items, each normalised by its own measured anchor, so the reference reaches 1.0 by construction when it reaches both: the offline item against anchor_offline.json (main's anchor, the privileged reference's mean_episode_score 0.9079890 on the three hidden episodes) and the online item against anchor_online.json (its episode_score 0.8974577 on the graded episode hidden-1). Confirmed by the dual mode's own ale validate (see the PR).
note: The component anchors live beside this file: anchor_offline.json (byte-identical to main's anchor.json) and anchor_online.json (the online variant's anchor.json). verify.py scores each item with its own anchor, cap and full_at, then writes ratio_rewards(mean, this anchor, cap 1.0, full_at 1.0).
